claims.claim_text: The indexed Captain Lloyd Black is a high-confidence match to Captain Lloyd D. Black, who participated in the OSS map-recovery work in Germany.

claims.match_notes: The source index omits a middle initial, and no personnel file was reviewed. The match remains high confidence rather than confirmed; the full private identifier is not published.
